notes: An example overlay, not a statement about any analyser.  The driver refuses every write of the sweep window and of the two bandwidths (MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET) until the operator states the ranges of the unit at this site; this file shows the shape of that overlay.  The example ranges describe a bench where the analyser is used over 0.9 to 1.1 GHz with spans of 1 MHz to 20 MHz and bandwidths of 1 kHz to 2 MHz.

frequency_center.reason: example: this bench uses the analyser over 0.9 to 1.1 GHz

frequency_span.reason: example: the spans of this bench are 1 MHz to 20 MHz

resolution_bandwidth.reason: example: the RBW values used at this bench are 1 kHz to 2 MHz

video_bandwidth.reason: example: the VBW values used at this bench are 1 kHz to 2 MHz
